summary: Sysco filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 on September 14, 2026, attaching audited and unaudited combined financials and MD&A for JRD and Affiliates (Jetro Restaurant Depot) plus Sysco unaudited pro forma statements, all incorporated by reference into Sysco/Sysco Holdings registration and prospectus materials tied to the previously announced March 30, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger. No new price, premium, or closing date is stated here; the filing is deal-supporting disclosure. What to watch: registration effectiveness, shareholder/antitrust clearances, and any revised deal terms or timing updates.
